note: The bay's drowned caves' adapter onto the material library (core/materials/PLAN.md; PLAN.md section 4). The rock's KGROUND layers (stations/cenote/84-host-rock.js): rock.limestone (the walls: rock.limestone.karst, nwbay's own karst set, as its stacks and sinkholes take it), rock.wet (the band at the waterline in the cenote's shaft: rock.wet.dark), stone.calcite (the flowstone and the calcite crust on the floors and the lower walls: stone.travertine); the dress takes stone.calcite. Run python3 tools/textures/pack.py biomes/nwbay-caves after any change, then python3 build.py.
